searchText: The proposer will pull the payload, right? So, if not signed for a specific builder, malicious builders could make other builder work for nothing by sending them a fake registration that is not supposed to arrive with them without the proposer being aware that it could pull from that tricked builder. Are registrations propagated or just a direct connection between proposer and builder? Today builders build every slot or they really check there's a registration for the slot ? Registrations are direct connections. The proposer pulls the bid Gas limit I wouldn't expect so, but other configurations make sense. For example it could be useful for pools to have different fee recipients per builder Or accept trusted/trustless per builder And if pools signal that they want to expose min bid configurations that also makes sense to be variable by builder. Haven't heard back from Lido nor ethstaker on this regard that's true, but today registration doesnt have this support and everything seems to work fine(?) so i was just curious what changed in epbs paradigm such that this is needs to be supported. Maybe trusted/trustless is one It changes that the proposer can get direct access to the builder And may want to have different deals with different ones Since registrations are direct connections, I don't see any issue with including more fields - providing more flexibility. Today, builders check at which relay the proposer is registered. Since registrations can be replayed to any relay by anyone (which has happened) builders cannot really trust that the proposer is actually registered at that relay or if the registration at another relay was replayed. Builders would then, in doupt, submit to the relay.
